description: Speckle-Reducing Anisotropic Diffusion adapted from Rodinia 3.1 SRAD v2. The shared-memory srad_cuda_1 / srad_cuda_2 kernels retain their arithmetic with guarded halo loads (fixed BLOCK_SIZE 16). Each iteration runs both kernels; q0sqr is recomputed on the CPU from the current image ROI.

scaling_param.name: image_size
scaling_param.description: Image dimension (NxN pixel grid, multiple of 16)

non_scaling_params.name: num_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: SRAD iterations per timed pass (each runs srad_cuda_1 + srad_cuda_2)

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
